{{Quote|We're under attack!|The sentry, witnessing the Republic's assault|<ref name="JY" />}}
An '''unidentified female Sephi''' served as a sentry guarding [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric's]] [[Alaric's palace|palace]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Along with a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], she ther crew of the [[Airspeeder/Legends|Sephi speeder]] known as [[Sentry Seven]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], seventeen [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the female sentry and her counterpart were ordered to do a fly-by on the position of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dekluun]], with whom the palace had lost contact. Once her speeder reached the suburbs of the palatial complex, the female sentry realized that the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had decimated Dekluun's troops and were heading to the palace, thus starting the [[Battle of Thustra]].<ref name="JY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Sephi sentry only appeared in the [[2004]] comic ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'', the fifth and final issue in the [[Star Wars: Jedi (one-shots)|''Star Wars: Jedi'']] series of comics, written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and illustrated by [[HOON]]. While the sentry went unnamed in the comics, she had several lines<ref name="JY" /> and HOON produced a detailed rendering of her as part of his conceptual "Sephi character catalogue."<ref name="HOON">{{WebCite|url=https://www.messs.cc/gallery/jujiyodacon/Pic1|text=Jedi: Yoda-Unsheathed&mdash;Character Sheet|work=Mess Studio Art Gallery|archivedate=20080118133434}}</ref>
